description: Reads the AI authoring chats of this workspace, where an owner describes an automation in words and Cosend builds it switched off. view list returns one number’s chats, most recently active first, each with its title (the owner’s first message) and the automations it holds. view chat returns one chat by id: what the owner said and each answer, with its outcome (built, changed, cannot, question, stopped), the automation it made, its Test result and the integrations still to connect. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

connection_id.description: With view list: the WhatsApp number whose authoring chats to list.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

view.description: list lists a number’s authoring chats. chat reads one chat with every answer in it.

name: get_authoring_chat
title: Read AI authoring chats
